bankOption.title: Bank connection
bankOption.description: Finansai fetches transactions from your bank through a secure bank connection. Tap Sync in the Inbox to get new ones.

notificationsOption.title: Bank notifications
notificationsOption.description: Finansai reads the payment notifications from your Swedbank app and turns them into suggestions. No bank connection needed.

disclosure.title: Allow Finansai to read bank notifications?
disclosure.intro: To suggest expenses from your payments, Finansai needs access to your notifications.
disclosure.whatIsRead: Only notifications from the Swedbank app are read.
disclosure.whereItGoes: Their text is sent to Finansai's server and to OpenAI to extract the amount, merchant and date.
disclosure.nothingElse: Notifications from other apps are never read, stored or sent.
disclosure.switchOff: You can switch this off at any time here or in Android settings.

access.howTo: Tap Open settings, find Finansai in the list and turn on notification access.

access.ready: All set. New Swedbank payments will appear in the Inbox when you open Finansai.
